name: areg
title: Areg Company Search
description: Search Norwegian companies and explore shareholders, roles, financials and more from areg.no
author: simenandre

commands.name: search-companies
commands.title: Search Companies
commands.subtitle: Areg
commands.description: Search Norwegian companies by name or organization number

commands.name: open-company-from-selection
commands.title: Open Company from Selection
commands.subtitle: Areg
commands.description: Open the company for the organization number in your selected text or clipboard

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Search Norwegian companies, people and industries by name or organization number, optionally limited to a business address (municipality, postcode, county or street).

tools.name: company
tools.title: Company
tools.description: Overview and key figures for one Norwegian company: name, form, address, industry, capital, employees and recent financials.

tools.name: financials
tools.title: Financials
tools.description: Income statement and balance sheet for one company, one year or all years. Amounts are in thousands of the reporting currency.

tools.name: shareholders
tools.title: Shareholders
tools.description: The shareholders of one company in a given register year, largest stake first.

tools.name: holdings
tools.title: Holdings
tools.description: The companies one company owns shares in, in a given register year.

tools.name: ownership-history
tools.title: Ownership History
tools.description: Changes in a company's ownership between register years: who came in, left, bought or was diluted.

tools.name: roles
tools.title: Roles
tools.description: Board, CEO, auditor and other roles in one company, and the periods it has had accountants, auditors and business managers.

tools.name: announcements
tools.title: Announcements
tools.description: Official announcements for one company (bankruptcy, merger, capital changes, annual accounts and more), with the facts each announcement states.

tools.name: grants
tools.title: Grants
tools.description: Public funding to one company, grouped by grantor: Innovation Norway grants, SkatteFUNN applications and the state aid register.

tools.name: tenders
tools.title: Tenders
tools.description: Public tenders from Doffin for one company since 2023: contracts won as supplier and notices published as buyer.

tools.name: tender
tools.title: Tender
tools.description: One Doffin notice: buyer, lots, who won each lot and the contract value where stated.

tools.name: financial-licenses
tools.title: Financial Licenses
tools.description: Licenses and registrations from the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway (Finanstilsynet) for one company.

tools.name: ip-rights
tools.title: IP Rights
tools.description: Patents, trademarks and designs at the Norwegian Industrial Property Office (Patentstyret) for one company.

tools.name: transport-licenses
tools.title: Transport Licenses
tools.description: Transport licenses for one company from the Norwegian Public Roads Administration: goods, van and coach licenses.

tools.name: group
tools.title: Group
tools.description: The corporate group a company belongs to: the ultimate parent and all subsidiaries, with the registered ownership share.

tools.name: person
tools.title: Person
tools.description: A person's shareholdings and roles in Norwegian companies, looked up by name and birth year.

tools.name: find-companies
tools.title: Find Companies
tools.description: Rank Norwegian companies by a financial figure, such as highest operating revenue, or all companies with net income above a threshold. Amounts are in thousands.

tools.name: query
tools.title: SQL Query
tools.description: Run read-only SQL (DuckDB dialect) against the full open areg dataset, for rankings, aggregates and joins the other tools do not cover.

ai.instructions: You answer questions about Norwegian companies using areg, which serves open Norwegian register data. Start with the search tool to find an organization number when you only have a name, then use the per-company tools. Tool responses are Markdown in Norwegian; answer in the user's language. Amounts from financials and find-companies are in thousands of the reporting currency, which is usually NOK. Link to https://areg.no/{orgnr} when you mention a company.
